image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a white ceramic cup with a red and pink floral or abstract pattern. The cup contains a dark liquid (likely tea or coffee) with visible solid ingredients (possibly fruit pieces or herbs). The handle is prominent on the right side. The background is a clean, out-of-focus white surface.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object is correctly classified as a cup and distinguish it from other vessels like bowls or mugs.
To verify the structural integrity of the handle attachment points, a common failure mode in AI-generated cups.
To ensure the interior depth is consistent with the exterior shape and that the rim does not melt into the background.
To check for subtle texture anomalies in the glaze or pattern distortion.

focus_areas: Pattern coherence across the curved surface
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the handle's connection to the body. AI often fails here by merging the handle into the cup wall without a clear gap or by having uneven thickness. Also, verify if the pattern wraps logically around the curvature of the cup or if it distorts unnaturally.
